svg.title: Index Translator browser components, reading aloud
svg.desc: The page's main module hands the reading controls to the speech UI module. It splits the text into utterances, asks the server for each one, and gives the audio to the player. The player keeps the requests ahead of playback in its buffer. The QOA module decodes compressed audio in a worker and falls back to WAV when the codec is not there. a sentence: public/speech-ui.ts → Server API. playback: public/speech-ui.ts → public/speech.ts → public/speech-buffer.ts.
